resources.string: Sign in required. Recordings upload to your own Google Drive.
Google needs you to sign in again before uploads can continue.
Drive access is needed to upload recordings. Sign in again and allow it.
No Google account is available on this phone. Add one in system settings, then try again.
This build has no Google client ID yet. Add GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID to local.properties and rebuild (see README).
The folder is created when the first upload runs.
No app could open the Drive folder.
No folder selected. Choose the folder where your phone saves call recordings.
Access to this folder was lost. Please choose it again.
The folder could not be read right now. If it is on an SD card, check that the card is inserted.
Android did not allow lasting access to that folder. Please try a different one.
No recordings found in this folder yet.
The location depends on your phone and recorder app. Common places are:
Samsung: Recordings/Call, or Call in older versions
Pixel: Recorder, or Music/Recordings/Call Recordings when using the Phone app\'s call recording
OnePlus / OPPO / realme: Music/Recordings/Call Recordings, or Recordings/Call

Not there? Make a short test call, then browse your Music and Recordings folders for the newest file. Android does not let apps read another app\'s private folder or the top level of storage, so a recorder that saves there has to be changed to save somewhere else.
Nothing synced yet. New recordings will appear here.
Skipped: the same recording is already in Drive.
The file no longer exists on this phone.
Access to the folder was lost. Choose the folder again.
Your Google Drive is full. Free up space, then retry.
Shown only while a recording is uploading.
Failed uploads, and successful ones if you turn that on.
Sign in again to keep uploading
Google needs you to confirm access to Drive.
Access to the folder was lost. Open the app to choose it again.
Sign in and choose a folder to start syncing.
No internet connection. Uploads will continue when you are back online.
Waiting for Wi-Fi. To use mobile data, turn off \"Upload on Wi-Fi only\".
Recordings upload to a \"Call Recordings\" folder in your own Drive. The app can only see files it creates there, not the rest of your Drive.
Pick the folder where your phone saves call recordings. The app reads audio files in that folder only.
New recordings upload automatically on Wi-Fi. You can change this in Settings.
Allow notifications so the app can tell you when an upload fails. Uploads still work if you say no.
Notifications are off. You can still check upload status on the home screen.
Your recordings go straight from this phone to your own Google Drive. This app has no server of its own and sends your files nowhere else. It has no analytics, and it does not record calls.
Selected folder: reads audio files only in the folder you choose.
Internet and network status: uploads to Drive and honors the Wi-Fi only setting.
Notifications: shows upload progress and failures.
Turn off to also upload using mobile data.
Upload new recordings automatically. Sync now always works.
Also look inside folders within the selected folder.
Notify after each file is uploaded.
Wait this long after a file last changed, so unfinished recordings are not uploaded.
Removes the activity list. Uploaded files stay in Drive and are not uploaded again.
Clear the activity list? Failed files will be tried again on the next sync.
Signs out and removes this app\'s access to Drive. Files already uploaded stay in your Drive.
Disconnect %1$s? Uploads stop until you sign in again.
